audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Aurora/Skill the edge at Levels 1 and 6 despite a 39.69% win rate over 131 games, and gave Ornn Level 3 while the prose for that stage says the trade is even chip.
audit.why: Ornn's Volcanic Rupture (Q, 9s at rank 1) builds the pillar Searing Charge (E, 14s) needs for its terrain knockup, and Aurora has no Across the Veil escape at Level 1. At 6 the Call of the Forge God elemental re-applies Brittle and its ground AoE is not dodged by Between Worlds. At Level 3 Aurora's Q+E poke does come online, making the stage genuinely even.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as an atomic group to Ornn / Ornn / Skill / Skill / Ornn / Ornn / Ornn, matching the packet chart and the existing stage prose.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level-6 text called Between Worlds a stage Aurora wins and used the wrong ability name 'Between the Worlds'.
audit.why: Aurora's ultimate is Between Worlds (140/120/100s). Ornn's Call of the Forge God is 140/120/100s and re-applies Brittle on the recast knockup; his real scaling spike is Living Forge self-upgrading Masterwork items plus stacked armour and MR.
audit.corrected: Level 6 now names Call of the Forge God as the stronger 6 spike and the ultimate is spelled Between Worlds; the two-item stage still belongs to Ornn.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown-level statement of the decisive interaction: Ornn's Searing Charge is on a SHORTER cooldown than Aurora's escape.
audit.why: Searing Charge is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s; Across the Veil is 22/21/20/19/18s. Aurora cannot W-dodge every charge, so the real answer is positional — deny the terrain his knockup requires rather than saving the leap. Volcanic Rupture (9s at rank 1) manufactures that terrain.
audit.corrected: Cooldown, trading and don't lines now state the 14s vs 22s asymmetry and the terrain requirement explicitly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown breakdown listed no real numbers, only 'matchup-defining' and 'track it'.
audit.why: The kit file gives exact per-rank cooldowns for every relevant spell.
audit.corrected: Replaced with Searing Charge 14s, Across the Veil 22s, Between Worlds 140s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated ability name 'Between the Worlds' in phases[4].why and breakdown.late.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon lists Aurora's R as Between Worlds.

edits.before: Between the Worlds zones the whole all-in — fights inside it are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ornn's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God knocks you up and re-Brittles you, and its ground AoE lands inside Between Worlds. Level 6 is his, not yours.

edits.before: Between the Worlds zones the whole all-in — build your teamfight around that. Ornn carry threat: 7/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Between Worlds walks you through walls to a pick — but its shockwave will not stop his R elemental. Ornn carry threat: 7/10 — take side lanes and vision instead.

edits.before: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — Wall-knockup setup. W-blink it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Searing Charge (E): 14s at rank 1 — his knockup needs terrain, so keep no wall at your back. - Across the Veil (W): 22s, longer than his E — never spend it on damage. - Between Worlds (R): 140s — kill or escape only.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack three passive hits on Ornn with Q-E weaving, cash the drain, and hop out before his answer lands. Great trade: Ornn wastes Volcanic Rupture — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Burning the hop for damage spacing — it is your KA answer; without it you are a immobile drain bot.
edits.after: Good trade: Q-curse, recast the pull-back for the second hit, and let Spirit Abjuration refund the chip. Great trade: he whiffs Searing Charge into open ground — no terrain, no knockup, punish the 14s. Bad trade: spending Across the Veil (W) on damage when it is 22s and his charge is 14s.

edits.before: Burning the hop for damage spacing — it is your KA answer; without it you are a immobile drain bot.
edits.after: Burning Across the Veil (W) on damage: 22s against his 14s Searing Charge, so the wall knockup is free.

edits.before: Wall-knockup setup. W-blink it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Q builds the wall Searing Charge needs — stand off terrain, no knockup.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Bellows Breath Brittles you: max-health damage plus tenacity shred.

notes: Kit-flag misfire: champ-data/_kits/ornn.json tags Volcanic Rupture (Q) with 'grounding', but Riot's own description for that spell says only damage, slow and a magma pillar — no grounding. Per the trust-the-description rule I did not assert grounding anywhere, and no existing Aurora vs Ornn text claimed it. Also unresolved from the kit data (needsResearch empty): whether Between Worlds' untargetable rift phase actually avoids the Call of the Forge God elemental's ground AoE. The existing bespoke content asserts it does NOT, and I kept that claim as written rather than reversing it, but it is not verifiable from Riot's text — flagged in unverified.
